title: Record approved code baseline
steps: Run git rev-parse HEAD|Compare full SHA to approved baseline|Record repository and branch
expected_result: Exact approved SHA; clean deployment source; no unapproved local change

title: Record frontend baseline
steps: Record repository commit build ID and artifact SHA-256|Compare deployed files
expected_result: Deployed frontend matches approved artifact

title: Record runtime and dependency versions
steps: Run python --version and pip freeze|Compare to approved dependency definition
expected_result: Python 3.12 and approved dependency set

title: Verify migration file integrity
steps: List migration revisions and SHA-256|Compare with Git baseline|Confirm no executed revision modified
expected_result: 30 revision files match baseline; head 20260902_29

title: Fresh database upgrade
steps: Run alembic upgrade head|Run current and check|List tables constraints indexes
expected_result: Upgrade succeeds to 20260902_29; check reports no operations

title: Historical database upgrade
preconditions: Approved pre-upgrade dump and isolated target
steps: Verify dump SHA and list|Restore|Record old revision|Upgrade to head|Run current/check
expected_result: All revisions apply; data preserved; no schema drift

title: Verify PR32 index and foreign keys
steps: Query pg_indexes and pg_constraint for purchase return NC index and four user FKs
expected_result: Index exists and is non-unique; expected FKs present

title: Verify application service installation
steps: Inspect service unit user working directory command restart policy and environment source|Start/restart service
expected_result: Service runs as approved non-root account and restarts cleanly

title: Verify health endpoints
steps: Call /health /health/live /health/ready|Compare version and revision
expected_result: All return expected status; readiness reports 20260902_29

title: Verify production configuration gates
steps: Start with SQLite weak secret auto-create and missing secret refs in separate trials
expected_result: Each unsafe production configuration refuses startup with controlled error

title: Verify LDAP transport configuration
steps: Inspect LDAPS StartTLS or plaintext risk switch|Check mode shown by readiness|Verify CA file permissions if encrypted
expected_result: Exactly one approved mode; certificate validation enabled unless approved plaintext risk

title: Verify database and service account privileges
steps: List database roles and grants|Inspect OS service account and file access
expected_result: Least privilege; migration and runtime duties separated; no broad write to audit evidence storage

title: Verify time synchronization
steps: Run timedatectl and time source status|Record timezone stratum offset and sync state|Compare database UTC
expected_result: Synchronized; offset within approved limit; timezone documented

title: Verify reverse proxy and TLS
steps: Inspect listener upstream TLS certificate CORS timeout and size limits|Test approved URL
expected_result: Configuration matches baseline; certificate valid; only approved origins

title: Verify logging and audit storage
steps: Inspect log paths permissions rotation capacity and database audit permissions
expected_result: Logs available to authorized roles; protected from ordinary modification; retention configured

title: Scan deployment for secrets
steps: Scan tracked files configuration output logs and evidence for known secret patterns without printing values
expected_result: No password token private key or full connection string exposed

title: Verify backup schedule and monitor
steps: Inspect timer/job frequency account target retention and alert receiver|Run dry/controlled job
expected_result: Schedule and alerting match approved design

title: Create and validate baseline backup
steps: Run controlled backup|Calculate SHA-256|Run pg_restore --list|Verify offsite/offline copy
expected_result: Backup readable; hash matches copies; evidence registered

title: Verify restore environment readiness
steps: Confirm target isolation capacity credentials and network controls|Verify no activity database target
expected_result: Safe isolated restore target ready; cannot overwrite production

title: Verify controlled file and evidence storage
steps: Inspect versioning access backup retention and immutability controls
expected_result: Authorized access only; version history and recovery available

title: Verify authentication throttle persistence
steps: Confirm login attempt table and cleanup/monitor configuration
expected_result: Throttle state persists across workers/restart as designed

title: Verify environment integration remains disabled
steps: Inspect gateway collector scheduler credentials and external alert configuration
expected_result: No unapproved real gateway or external alert channel active

title: Verify deferred interfaces remain disabled
steps: Inspect JZT and traceability adapters jobs endpoints and credentials
expected_result: No production adapter scheduling or credentials active

title: Verify test accounts and role data
steps: List test users roles warehouses review dates and expiries|Check conflicts
expected_result: Accounts unique active trained and non-conflicting; warehouse scopes ready

title: Verify rollback readiness
steps: Confirm pre-change backup application artifact previous config and rollback commands|Perform tabletop review
expected_result: Rollback decision point owner commands and evidence defined and usable
